compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: LMV331IDBVR assigns 1IN+ (IN_POS) whereas TLV3201AIDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: LMV331IDBVR assigns 1IN- (IN_NEG) whereas TLV3201AIDBVR assigns IN+ (IN_POS) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 4: LMV331IDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) whereas TLV3201AIDBVR assigns IN- (IN_NEG) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VCC pin (VCC+ vs VCC).

Single SOT-23-5 op-amps vary in pin ordering across vendors; verify Pin 1–5.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Soldering TLV3201AIDBVR onto a LMV331IDBVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL OUTPUT STAGE DIFFERENCE: LMV331IDBVR (open-collector) vs TLV3201AIDBVR (push-pull): the open-collector/open-drain output can only sink current and requires an external pull-up resistor to reach logic-high, whereas the push-pull output actively drives both rails (a pull-up tied to a different rail can back-drive a push-pull stage).

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (LMV331IDBVR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=Non-RR vs TLV3201AIDBVR: IN=RR, OUT=RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.
HIGH SWITCHING TIMING SHIFT: Propagation delay differs by 7x (LMV331IDBVR: 300 ns p.6 vs TLV3201AIDBVR: 43 ns p.5); verify overcurrent/zero-crossing trip latency and hysteresis timing.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: LMV331IDBVR has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (5.5 V, p.4) than TLV3201AIDBVR (7 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 5.5 V.
engineering_verdict: LMV331IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TLV3201AIDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Signal-chain deltas: propagation delay 300 ns (p.6) vs 43 ns (p.5), supply ceiling 5.5 V (p.4) vs 5.5 V (p.4), Vos 7 mV (p.6) vs 3 mV (p.5), Ib 5x gap (5 vs 1 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: LMV331IDBVR "Reversed U-Pinout SOT-23-5 (Pin 1 = IN+, Pin 4 = OUT) — Incompatible With TLV3201 & TLV7011" (p.3) and TLV3201AIDBVR "Push-Pull Output — Do NOT Wired-AND or Pull Up to a Different Logic Rail" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose LMV331IDBVR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-5 (DBV) qualification and -40..125 °C grade; choose TLV3201AIDBVR when DC precision demands <= 3 mV max Vos or single-supply ADC headroom demands full Rail-to-Rail I/O swing. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
